achievements.name: Never Miss a Beat
achievements.description: Land five consecutive main attacks with clean timing, without missing or losing health between them.

achievements.name: Cut the Night Apart
achievements.description: Parry 25 moving enemy projectiles with Baguette attacks in one run.

achievements.name: One Swing, Five Silences
achievements.description: Parry five moving enemy projectiles with one Baguette swing or dash spin.

achievements.name: A Hair from the Grave
achievements.description: Perform a perfect dodge against a damaging attack.

achievements.name: Three Ways to Die
achievements.description: Perfect-dodge a moving projectile, a charging enemy and a ground attack in the same run.

achievements.name: The Night Cannot Touch Me
achievements.description: Perform ten perfect dodges without losing health between them in one run.

achievements.name: An Exit Wound
achievements.description: Land 25 dash strikes in one run.

achievements.name: A Heart That Will Not Slow
achievements.description: Keep at least three Momentum stacks for 30 continuous seconds of active combat.

achievements.name: Room for One More
achievements.description: Hit five different living enemies with a single combo finisher.

achievements.name: Thread the Throats
achievements.description: Damage five different living enemies with one main Espresso projectile.

achievements.name: Scald the Dark
achievements.description: Clear five moving enemy projectiles with one Scalding Chai cast.

achievements.name: The Bell Answers Back
achievements.description: Block a damaging attack with Copper Cocoa and hit its attacker with the countershock.

achievements.name: A Bloom for Your Grave
achievements.description: Damage the same enemy with Briar Tea's opening strike, a pulse and its final bloom in one cast.

achievements.name: Wish Upon a Falling Corpse
achievements.description: Hit a staggered major boss with Falling-star Cordial.

achievements.name: Pulled Under
achievements.description: Defeat three different enemies with main attacks while they remain marked by one Undertow Tonic cast.

achievements.name: Seconds Well Spent
achievements.description: Fill Midnight Cold Brew's damage store to its cap and hit an enemy with the closing burst.

achievements.name: Breathe Between Blows
achievements.description: Recover at least ten actual health from Minted Pea Soup's perfect-dodge healing in one run.

achievements.name: A Steady Hand
achievements.description: Trigger Three-herb Congee's clean-hit healing three times in one major-boss encounter, recovering health each time.

achievements.name: Sugar Saves the Skin
achievements.description: Let Sugar-shell Squash absorb an entire incoming hit, leaving your health unchanged.

achievements.name: Borrowed from the Blow
achievements.description: Use Pickled Thunderroots to remove at least five seconds of active special recharge through perfect dodges in one encounter.

achievements.name: Service After Hours
achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with the pulse produced by After-hours Fondue.

achievements.name: There and Back Again
achievements.description: Hit the same major boss on both outward and returning passes of one Returning Noodles blade.

achievements.name: The Whole Conversation
achievements.description: In one 20-second active-combat window, perfect-dodge a major boss and hit it with a dash strike, a combo finisher and your special.

achievements.name: Dawn in a Cup
achievements.description: Evolve Midnight Espresso into Sunrise Kouign-amann.

achievements.name: A Thousand Sharp Edges
achievements.description: Evolve Baguette Ronin into Thousand-layer Crown.

achievements.name: Tempered in the Dark

achievements.name: Six Seats at Supper
achievements.description: Fill all six combat-perk slots in one run.

achievements.name: An Acquired Taste

achievements.name: The Recipe Forks

achievements.description: Perfect-dodge to empower an Eclipse Truffle special, hit a major boss with it, then defeat that boss.

achievements.name: The Complete Cellar
achievements.description: Defeat a major boss with each of the six special drinks selected, across your runs.

achievements.name: Both Sides of the Recipe

achievements.name: Three Jars, No Reassurance
achievements.description: Carry three different merchant relics at once.

achievements.description: Replace a carried relic at the dealer, then defeat the next major boss without replacing that new relic.

achievements.name: A Few Seconds in a Jar
achievements.description: Spend a full three-second Hourglass Saffron bank on a special cast.

achievements.name: Sweet Revenge

achievements.name: Season to Taste
achievements.description: Use Cinder Salt to consume a burn and kill a different enemy with the resulting splash.

achievements.name: Cancel the Debt
achievements.description: Cancel Cracked Nutmeg's delayed damage with a landed finisher before the debt is paid.

achievements.name: Saved for the Living
achievements.description: Preserve a boss-healing pickup with Moon-brined Olives, then consume its entire saved portion in that encounter.

achievements.name: One Good Thing Remains
achievements.description: Keep an upgrade card with Widow's Marmalade during a reroll, then choose that kept card.

achievements.name: A Second Helping
